item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Partial yes, mostly on economic shocks. Xi’s system did use fiscal, monetary, housing, and labor measures to soften suffering, but the response was opaque, Party-controlled, and still judged by outside observers as incomplete. I found little direct 2024 evidence on pandemics, disasters, or conflict displacement; the record is concentrated on economic distress and social protection.

**Evidence For**

That is direct crisis-mitigation language during a weak-demand period. | 6B.6 |

It is strong evidence of a targeted response to the property shock. | 6B.6 |

This is measured fiscal mitigation of hardship. | 6B.6, 6B.4, 6B.2 |

**Evidence Against / Limits**

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level note | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| IMF completes 2024 Article IV mission on China | IMF | 2024-05-28 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/05/28/pr24184-china-imf-staff-completes-2024-art-iv-mission | The IMF said output was below potential, inflation was subdued, and more easing plus exchange-rate flexibility were still needed. That implies the crisis response was incomplete. | 6B.6 |
| IMF 2024 Article IV Consultation staff report | IMF | 2024-08-02 | https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/08/01/peoples-republic-of-china-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-552803 | The IMF said China still needed stronger social safety nets, debt consolidation, and a more comprehensive reform package. That weakens a claim of fully competent harm reduction. | 6B.6 |
| China’s home destocking push to bring developers little cheer | Reuters | 2024-06-09 | https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/chinas-home-destocking-push-to-bring-developers-little-cheer-3476774 | Reuters said the de-stocking program was too small to help cash-strapped developers much. That suggests partial stabilization, not a full crisis remedy. | 6B.6 |
| China unveils steps to tackle hidden debt of local governments | Reuters | 2024-11-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/china-unveils-steps-to-tackle-hidden-debt-of-local-governments-2347705/ | The debt swap improved transparency but also raised official debt and squeezed new project funding. That looks like risk management after overborrowing, not durable relief. | 6B.6 |
| China passes law granting Communist Party more control over cabinet | Reuters | 2024-03-11 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-passes-law-granting-communist-party-more-control-over-cabinet-3331891 | The State Council law revision increased Party control over the cabinet and removed some accountability space. That undercuts a transparent, feedback-driven crisis response. | 6B.6, 6B.4, 6B.5 |
| China cancels premier’s press conference for first time since 1993 | Reuters | 2024-03-04 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/china-cancels-premiers-press-conference-for-first-time-since-1993-3322647 | Removing one of the few recurring public accountability venues reduced transparency and external scrutiny. That weakens confidence that mistakes would be openly corrected. | 6B.6, 6B.5 |

**Search Gap**
I did not find strong 2024 evidence on pandemic response, disaster relief, conflict displacement, or famine-specific mitigation. The usable record was concentrated on economic shocks, housing, and social protection. Most positive evidence is official or quasi-official reporting of policy intent and administrative outputs, not independent outcome audits.
